operator_summary.purpose: Milestone contracts for the historical-first EUR/USD research path. Read this summary first, then use each active milestone's scope, acceptance criteria, fixed verification and real-world proof contract.
milestone_actions: Inspect the current state and active contract before work.
Implement the active milestone only and retain required artifacts.
Run the fixed verification commands and capture the declared real-world proof.
Independently verify the retained proof, record checks and evidence, obtain the required review and human decision, then prove the milestone.
Start the next milestone only after the current one is proven or has an explicitly recorded human exception.

current_state.non_duplication_rule: This registry intentionally does not copy mutable status, timestamps, evidence or completion claims. project_state.json is the current execution summary; the registry remains the fixed contract.

acceptance_criteria.description: Initial repository state and inspected reference repository revisions are documented truthfully.
Retained Autonomous Framework concepts and deliberately excluded machinery are documented.
Inspected AI Lab services, boundaries, networking constraints, and unresolved dependencies are documented without invented claims.
Root AGENTS.md contains concise future-session operating rules.
Python package installation succeeds in a fresh isolated environment without inherited system packages.
Typed configuration loads and validates every initial YAML configuration file.
Unknown fields, invalid runtime modes, forbidden server changes, and unsafe live flags fail validation.
Configuration precedence and secret handling are documented and tested.
Project state, milestone registry, run history, and evidence manifests validate through machine-readable JSON Schemas.
Every registry milestone declares a real-world execution proof.
Closeout refuses incomplete, stale, mismatched, dirty or proof-free milestones.
A non-empty automated test suite passes.
Repository-level verification passes.
A fresh isolated-environment M0 execution evidence bundle is captured from the repository under the declared SELF_ATTESTED_INTEGRITY assurance tier.
The independent M0 evidence verifier passes without modifying the captured bundle.
A negative control proves the evidence verifier rejects a tampered or incomplete bundle.
No secret or sensitive file is tracked.
Documentation describes observed reality and labels uninspected infrastructure or assumptions.
The human operator reviews the foundation, evidence, deferred work, and safety boundaries and records approval.

The Forex T480 adapter remains catalog-locked, shared-core based, and read-only. It exposes no arbitrary command, deployment mutation, generic MT5 API, generic market-data, arbitrary account, or order surface; its sole MT5 exception is the fixed m1_mt5_demo_probe, which is Demo-only and exports exactly 720 closed EUR/USD H1 bars for M1 preparation.
Four isolated read-only Triad-plus-domain reviews, bound to the current commit, configuration, verifier, contract, and real-world evidence, produce a deterministic completion recommendation.

The repo-wide SELF_ATTESTED_INTEGRITY tier and its limitations are explicit, machine-validated, and protected by a fixed-job local runner signature, hashes, freshness, revision/configuration binding, tamper rejection, Triad review, and human approval.
